description: Complete reproducibility package for the study 'Apparent versus generalizable performance of an ESCC transcriptomic prognostic model: quantifying selection leakage and overfitting, with a TRIPOD-informed audit and PROBAST assessment of 205 studies' (submitted to Journal of Translational Medicine). Contains: (1) all analysis scripts (numbered 01-35 in execution order); (2) all intermediate result files (74 files, including nested cross-validation, pipeline bootstrap with B=500, and the 100-split control decomposition); (3) the complete literature-audit dataset of 205 published ESCC prognostic-model studies (PubMed, 2015-2026) with TRIPOD item coding, an independent second rule set for agreement estimation (mean Cohen's kappa = 0.802), and PROBAST assessments; (4) MSigDB gene-set subsets (KEGG, GO BP, Hallmark). Raw TCGA-ESCA and GEO expression data are public and not included; download instructions are in the README. Code is MIT-licensed; derived data remain subject to the original TCGA/GEO terms.
notes: Random seeds are fixed inside each script. See README.md for the full reproduction protocol. The failed GSE53624 external-validation attempt (platform annotation without gene symbols) is documented in the repository and in the manuscript Limitations. v1.1 (2026-10-27) replaces all hardcoded sandbox absolute paths in the 21 analysis scripts with dynamic repository-root resolution (R: Sys.getenv('ESCC_ROOT'); Python: os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)); shell: BASH_SOURCE). No scientific results or outputs changed. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23643162 always resolves to the latest version.
